description: This file provides a collection of utility functions and class definitions related to tensor manipulation, axis normalization, type casting, and conversion operations within the PyTorch framework. It includes functions for axis normalization, tensor casting, shape expansion, and internal conversions relevant to PyTorch tensors, particularly in the context of comparing and integrating with numpy-like behavior.

classes.name: AxisError
classes.description: Custom exception class for axis-related errors, inheriting from ValueError and IndexError.

classes.name: UFuncTypeError
classes.description: Custom exception class for type errors related to universal functions, inheriting from TypeError and RuntimeError.

methods.name: is_sequence(seq)
methods.description: Checks if the input is a sequence (but not a string).

methods.name: cast_if_needed(tensor, dtype)
methods.description: Casts a tensor to a specified dtype if needed.

methods.name: cast_int_to_float(x)
methods.description: Converts integer and boolean tensors to float tensors using the default float dtype.

methods.name: normalize_axis_index(ax, ndim, argname=None)
methods.description: Normalizes a single axis index, handling negative indices within bounds.

methods.name: normalize_axis_tuple(axis, ndim, argname=None, allow_duplicate=False)
methods.description: Normalizes an axis argument into a tuple of non-negative axes, handling duplicates if specified.

methods.name: allow_only_single_axis(axis)
methods.description: Ensures that the axis argument specifies only a single axis.

methods.name: expand_shape(arr_shape, axis)
methods.description: Expands a shape to include singleton dimensions at specified axes, similar to numpy.expand_dims.

methods.name: apply_keepdims(tensor, axis, ndim)
methods.description: Reshapes a tensor to keep dimensions after reduction, expanding or reshaping as needed.

methods.name: axis_none_flatten(*tensors, axis=None)
methods.description: Flattens tensors if axis is None, or returns them unchanged with the axis.

methods.name: typecast_tensor(t, target_dtype, casting)
methods.description: Typecasts a tensor to a target dtype with a specified casting rule.

methods.name: typecast_tensors(tensors, target_dtype, casting)
methods.description: Typecasts multiple tensors to a target dtype.

methods.name: _try_convert_to_tensor(obj)
methods.description: Attempts to convert an object to a tensor, raising detailed errors on failure.

methods.name: _coerce_to_tensor(obj, dtype=None, copy=False, ndmin=0)
methods.description: Core logic for converting an object into a tensor, with options for dtype, copying, and minimum dimensions.

methods.name: ndarrays_to_tensors(*inputs)
methods.description: Converts array-like inputs (including custom ndarray objects) to tensors, recursively if needed.
